component.name: Minesweeper 2.0
component.summary: Classic minesweeper with levels, items, coin shop and achievements

description.p: A hand-written minesweeper: the classic rules first, then 36 levels, three items, a coin shop, 31 achievements, themes, bilingual UI and fully synthesized sound effects.
Classic rules: left click to reveal, right click to cycle flag/question/empty, double click or middle click to chord, first click is always safe, timer starts on the first reveal.
Linux 端界面按 Windows v1.5 重做：状态栏卡片、物品栏、商店浮层、关卡卡片、关于窗口与彩蛋。
修复：放大镜透视不显示内容、声呐区域不留痕、切换难度后棋盘格宽不对、成就/关于页文案。
新增：声呐扫过的区域在棋盘上标浅蓝；版本号加 -Linux 后缀区分平台。
